children: Ravindranath brings extensive experience across procurement, operations and aerospace after leadership roles at Pratt & Whitney and Cyient
Rolls-Royce has appointed Sandeep Ravindranath as Vice President, Procurement Operations, bringing extensive experience across procurement, supply chain, operations and aerospace.

Ravindranath joins Rolls-Royce from Pratt & Whitney, where he served as Associate Director, Global Procurement. He has held leadership roles across procurement, operations and process transformation during his career.

Before Pratt & Whitney, Ravindranath spent more than 13 years with Cyient, progressing through roles spanning operations, aftermarket planning and transformation. He began his career with Sartorius, working across materials planning, procurement and operations.

In his new role, Ravindranath will contribute to strengthening procurement operations and operational excellence at Rolls-Royce. He holds a degree in Industrial Engineering and Management from M S Ramaiah Institute of Technology and an MBA in Operations and Marketing from IIM Kozhikode.
